Applications

Activated carbon solutions for water treatment, gold recovery, air and gas purification, oil and gas, chloramine removal, and specialty industrial processes. Includes coconut shell activated carbon manufactured and exported from India for dependable regional and global supply.

  • Water Treatment - Granular, powder, impregnated, and catalytic grades for drinking water, municipal systems, and wastewater purification.
  • Gold Recovery - Microporous coconut shell carbon grades for CIP, CIC, and tank-adsorbed precious-metal recovery systems.
  • Air & Gas - Coconut shell and impregnated grades for indoor air quality, protection equipment, flue gas, and odor control.
  • Oil & Gas - Activated carbon for vapor recovery, H2S removal, condensate polishing, and low-silica boiler-feed protection.
  • Catalytic / Chloramine Removal - Specialty catalytic carbon for chloramine decomposition and hydrogen sulfide control in drinking-water systems.
  • Other Applications - Specialty grades for solvent recovery, food and beverage purification, edible oil, and related industrial processes.
